metcon.name: Workout
metcon.description:
Warm Up Equipment:
PVC Pipe
Red Band
Empty Barbell
Box
Rope / Rig
1 Round:
30sec e/s PVC Shoulder Opener
5 PVC Around the Worlds each way
5 PVC Pass Throughs
10 Band Row → Rotate → Press
5e/s World’s Greatest Stretch
10 Air Squats
5e/s Alternating Box Step-Ups
5 Box Jump + Step Down
2 Rounds:
Gymnastics
5 Scap Pull-Ups
5 Beat Swings
3 Kip Swings + Hip-to-Bar
2–3 Low Rope Foot Locks / Standing Rope Pulls
2 Box Jump Overs
Barbell
3 Muscle Cleans
3 Hang Power Cleans
3 Power Cleans
3 Push Press
3 Push Jerks
2 Clean & Jerks
Then 3–4 minutes workout prep:
Build clean & jerk weight while testing gymnastics:
1 Rope Climb
2–3 Bar Muscle-Ups / chosen scale
2 Box Jump Overs
1 Clean & Jerk - build up to working weight

hypertrophy.reasoning: Today emphasizes pressing, pulling, and gymnastic shoulder work; accessorize antagonists and weak-point builders.

raw_text:
Workout | YGIG Partner workout 30 min AMRAP
Each round consists of
1 Rope Climb
4 Bar Muscle-Ups
8 Box Jump Overs 24/20”
Each person does 1 full round then they come together to do
10 clean and jerks @ 80/50kg
Can be split jerk or push jerk
Scale rope climb to partial rope climb or 2 x controlled rope climbs from the floor
scale muscle up to 4 banded muscle ups, 6 C2B or 8 pull ups
Scale # of reps to finish each YGIG portion within 2 minutes
